cpu_regressions.method: Actual locked function/class bodies loaded via AST with import isolation and torch.compile decorators removed; tensor emulation of the Triton combine body. Not native CUDA or an installed production image test.

baseline_control.note: The same 132-case harness runs against the original 32-patch baseline. Failures include parameter variants and new helper methods absent from the baseline; 55 failures do not mean 55 distinct defects.

official_source_trees.method: Official GitHub codeload archives, canonical Git trees, locked patch SHA256, git apply --index, resulting Git trees. Submodule gitlinks verified; submodule worktrees not materialized.

verify_patches_full_command.reason: Docker Hub auth.docker.io:443 connection timed out; source checks completed before the registry request.
verify_patches_full_command.note: The original all-in-one command was not rerun. Its base-image check is now covered by raw manifest/config hashes and local RootFS verification; recursive source preparation and installed identity gates also passed during the image build.

checks: Python 3.12 py_compile for new Python entrypoints

full_image_build.note: Built and loaded locally on Linux amd64; not published. Preinstalled the pinned FlashInfer source compiler requirements to prevent nested uv installer locking; passed the existing intended Triton unit-test build setting through TRITON_APPEND_CMAKE_ARGS. Reused checksum-verified cubin artifacts through a temporary loopback HTTP cache; the original pinned downloader still verified manifest and file hashes.

installed_image_cpu_suite.method: Locked upstream CPU suite plus all 132 compatibility cases in the built image. Compatibility cases retain AST import isolation and Triton tensor emulation; this is not native GPU or model inference validation.
installed_image_cpu_suite.counting_note: JUnit counts include 480 passing subtests: 895 passing pytest cases + 480 passing subtests + 1 CUDA skip = 1376 entries. All 132 compatibility cases are included in the 895 passing pytest cases.

native_cuda_triton_cuda_graph.scope: Native Triton Markov greedy combine and CUDA Graph replay, batch sizes 1/3/8/16, normal and NaN sentinel cases.

model_inference_quality_and_performance.note: Functional scenarios and short concurrent requests; not a throughput benchmark, quality comparison or proof of complete sampling equivalence. No production prompts or responses are published.

deployment.note: Existing image deployed and qualified. Source publication does not rebuild the image or change the running service. Public launcher has configurable paths, devices, endpoint and credentials; engine parameters match the qualified deployment.

installed_source_identity.method: Unchanged prepare-sources.py verified locked commits, recursive submodules, patch hashes and final trees using a read-only Git object cache; verify-installed.py rechecked all four installed source trees and package identities.
